text: The decoction remaining after the distillation of the oil, afford, by infiltration, an useful extract of a mold, bitterth, albalkringed tafte. Hufman fays, he has given it with great benefits, in doses of a teruple, as a corroborant in cachethe cafes, in the decline of interming fevers, and for abating hypochondriacal fpafms.
